svg.aria-label: The model: the input video, the target camera and the noised target picture are each turned into tokens and concatenated into one sequence of 321 tokens; a transformer processes it, and the target positions are read out as the clean picture. Sampling repeats this for 16 steps.
svg.text: 12 blocks of plain self-attention over the whole sequence
only the 64 target positions are read: they hold the predicted clean patches
